settings.title: FAMILY OWNED. BUILT AROUND GOOD TECH.
settings.content:
Unpatched Tech is a family-owned business built by people who actually use, repair, and care about the hardware we sell.

We focus on refurbished consoles, custom PCs, repairs, restorations, and practical upgrades that keep good technology in use longer. We are not trying to be a giant electronics warehouse. We would rather do a smaller number of things well, be clear about what we sell, and stand behind the work we put our name on.

Whether you are buying a system, sending in a repair, or building a new PC, the goal is the same: straightforward service, carefully handled hardware, and tech that is ready to keep going.
